brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball news thumbnail by transforming the approved black/lime style reference into a different composition for a new article. Output PNG, landscape 16:9, preferably 1536x864 or 1792x1024, width over 1000px.
Input image 1 (B-culver-black-lime-v3.png): style reference ONLY. Keep its charcoal-black #151A18 and acid-lime #CCF43B palette, bold Japanese typography and expressive hand-drawn ink/brush visual language. REMOVE all previous article text, numbers and previous person. Do not repeat its shooting pose.
Input image 2 (official portrait): identity reference ONLY for the real professional player Jake Layman. Use his recognisable likeness as an INK ILLUSTRATION: fair skin, elongated oval/rectangular face and firm chin, high forehead, short light brown/dark blond hair side-parted and swept up/back with shorter sides, light eyes, straight long nose, broad mouth, clean-shaven. Athletic tall lean muscular build. No beard. Do not copy/paste or photomanipulate the photo.
Subject: Jake Layman alone in an energetic driving pose, torso leaning diagonally forward, ball controlled under one hand at hip height, other arm naturally bent for balance. Face in a readable three-quarter view, focused expression. Keep both hands anatomically credible and visible, five fingers per hand, no extra limbs, ball connected naturally to the dribbling hand. Mid-thigh-up framing is fine. This is a generic imagined basketball action, not an actual game or scoring moment. Wear a plain unbranded sleeveless charcoal jersey with lime trim, WITHOUT any name, number, sponsors, team or league marks. No other people.
Composition: large uncluttered headline block on the LEFT 55%; illustrated player filling RIGHT 45%, face comfortably inside frame, dynamic asymmetric curved lime brush sweep behind him. One orange basketball as his prop. Plenty of clean dark space around typography. Do not cover words with the person or ball. Preserve broad safe margins (at least 55px). Make the figure clearly drawn with black contour marks and painterly cream/gray shading, emphatically not photographic or 3D.
Text to render EXACTLY in Japanese, with no other text:
small upper left: "バスケまとめ"
large lime date below: "10/26"
largest white heavy headline: "試合結果"
bold lime secondary headline: "当日のEFF"
smaller white descriptor: "ポジション別TOP3"
clear footer along bottom left, readable with generous margin: "イラスト（AI生成）"
and next to it: "イメージ"
Do not add a player's name, individual stats, scoreline, player ranking, claims of participation or performance. The article is a roundup of 2026-10-26 game results and that day's position-specific official EFF top 3. Do not imply season-average ranking or predictions. The depicted player was chosen randomly from the article's names. No team/league logo, no official photo, no watermark besides the requested AI illustration footer. All text crisp and correctly spelled. Visually polished, restrained, mobile-readable.

generator.qa_method: 生成画像を実際に表示して目視検品。文字・数値、当日/ポジション別の限定、公式写真と顔の特徴、手の形、文字・顔・両手の見切れ、AI生成表記を確認。
